capabilities: render Lilypond code blocks as sheet music
configure the path to the Lilypond executable
accept arbitrary Lilypond code in fenced code blocks
extras: The maintainer notes they do not hold full rights to the project and that the software license may be incorrect. Lilypond must be installed separately and its executable path set in settings; Linux and Windows default paths are documented.
problem: Obsidian cannot render Lilypond music notation, so users who want sheet music inside their notes have no built-in way to compile it.
summary: Music renderer that converts Lilypond code blocks in notes into rendered sheet music images using a local Lilypond installation.
